transcript: OK so that was session twelve with Dana. She came in saying the week was better, actually the first decent week in a while, she slept maybe six hours most nights instead of four, and she thinks the sleep thing is because she finally started the wind-down routine we agreed on. Work is still the main stressor, the restructure is happening and she does not know yet whether her role survives it, they told the team it would be decided by the end of the month. She got tearful about halfway through when she talked about her sister, they have not spoken since the wedding, and she said she feels like she is the one who always has to reach out first. We sat with that for a while. She did say she has been thinking about messaging her this weekend, which is new. She was asked directly and denies SI, no plan, no intent, and she says the intrusive thoughts from the spring are much quieter now. She has been taking the sertraline at fifty milligrams consistently, no side effects she notices, and she wants to stay on it. We agreed she would write the message to her sister without sending it, and we would read it together next week. I want to look at how she talks about being the one who reaches out, that pattern shows up with her mother too.
